# Version 3.0.0
> **Modernized cross-platform v3** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/3.0.0-preview.5.4)

> **Superseded by [3.116.0](3.116.0.md)** · Never released as stable — these changes rolled up into 3.116.0.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](3.0.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.0 modernizes the bindings, renderer, and supported platform integrations for current .NET applications. The preview line adds new graphics APIs, refreshed native dependencies, expanded desktop and mobile support, and removes long-obsolete APIs.

## Breaking Changes

- **Obsolete APIs were removed** — APIs previously marked obsolete were removed for the v3 release. Update code to the recommended replacement APIs and rebuild before moving to this version. ([#2539](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2539), [#2789](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2789))
- **Platform view integrations were modernized** — Several platform-view packages and target frameworks changed as part of the v3 refresh. Update package references and platform project settings to their current supported equivalents. ([#2317](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2317), [#2598](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2598), [#2733](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2733), [#2788](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2788), [#2989](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2989))

## Engine

- **Skia and bundled dependencies refreshed** — The preview line updates Skia through milestone m116 and refreshes HarfBuzz, WebP, and libjpeg-turbo. — ❤️ [@Redth](https://github.com/Redth) ([#2622](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2622), [#2624](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2624), [#2699](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2699), [#2829](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2829), [#2885](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2885), [#3026](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3026))

## API Surface

- **New graphics and span-based APIs** — The release adds SKBlender, Skottie animation support, expanded SKPicture APIs, shader conversion, and span overloads for point and color-filter operations. — ❤️ [@Youssef1313](https://github.com/Youssef1313) ([#2630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2630), [#2748](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2748), [#2775](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2775), [#2830](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2830), [#2883](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2883), [#2879](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2879), [#2949](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2949), [#3030](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3030))

## Bug Fixes

- **Rendering and lifetime fixes** — Fixes address Metal snapshot colors, cloned SKPaint disposal, kerning adjustment results, and pixel-span offset handling. — ❤️ [@taublast](https://github.com/taublast), [@pdjonov](https://github.com/pdjonov), [@jeremy-visionaid](https://github.com/jeremy-visionaid) ([#2804](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2804), [#2858](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2858), [#2904](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2904), [#2609](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2609))

## Platform

- **Expanded view and runtime support** — SkiaSharp adds accelerated WinUI views, WPF GL support, Mac Catalyst Metal rendering, and updated mobile and WebAssembly integrations. — ❤️ [@gmurray81](https://github.com/gmurray81), [@jeromelaban](https://github.com/jeromelaban) ([#2317](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2317), [#2598](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2598), [#2733](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2733), [#2747](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2747), [#2559](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2559), [#2563](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2563), [#2970](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2970))

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.0

Updates the bundled HarfBuzz library and keeps text-shaping support aligned with the v3 platform refresh.
